LESSON: LANGUAGE STRATEGIES ON DAILY EXPERIENCES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1.1: Language Strategies on Daily Experiences

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Language Strategies on Daily Experiences
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do we celebrate national days?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe national events fluently and with expression
2. compose songs based on patriotism for expression
3. value the place of national days in promoting ethnic cohesion

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe national events fluently and with expression
• Model 2: compose songs based on patriotism for expression
• Model 3: value the place of national days in promoting ethnic cohesion

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe national events fluently and with expression
2. Practise: compose songs based on patriotism for expression
3. Practise: value the place of national days in promoting ethnic cohesion

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Language Strategies on Daily Experiences.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we celebrate national days?
2. How can we describe an event interestingly?
